unit_of_observation: one fictional participant in a cognitive-training trial
unit_of_assignment: individual participant within prespecified baseline-anxiety stratum
exposure_mechanism: exactly half of the low-anxiety stratum and exactly half of the high-anxiety stratum are randomly assigned cognitive training after a deterministic-seed shuffle
target_estimand: average total effect of training assignment in the eligible trial cohort, plus prespecified total effects within baseline-anxiety strata
warning: This simulation is not a validated model of cognition, anxiety, strategy use, or training. Strategy use is post-assignment and is confounded with follow-up memory by an omitted self-regulation variable, so mediator-conditioned coefficients are not identified direct effects.
causal_structure: random assignment affects strategy use and follow-up memory
baseline anxiety modifies the assignment effect and predicts strategy use and outcome
baseline memory predicts strategy use and outcome
latent self-regulation predicts strategy use and outcome
strategy use affects follow-up memory in the generator

structural_equations.training_assignment: exactly half assigned 1 within each baseline-anxiety stratum after a deterministic-seed shuffle
